description: List tool calls parked awaiting human approval ('approval' permission tier — see agent_tool_permissions/role_tool_permissions). Filtered and paged: status defaults to 'pending', limit to 20 (max 100), oldest first; page with offset (next_offset in the answer). Long arguments are shortened in the list and results are omitted — pass id for one call in full.

id.description: One pending call by id — returned with full arguments and result (status then defaults to 'all').

include_result.description: Also return the stored result of executed calls.

offset.description: For paging; use next_offset from the previous answer.

since.description: Only calls created at/after this ISO date or date-time.

tool_name.description: Exact tool name, or with * as wildcard (e.g. esd__*).

name: list_pending_tool_calls
